finalText:
It builds clean now, 0 errors.

Two spots broke from the bump. In `src/core/options.js`, the new bundler renames a setting from `retries` to `retryCount`, but the code still read the old name, so it crashed. I pointed it at the new name. In `src/net/retryPolicy.js`, a missing setting now shows up as `undefined` instead of `false`, and the check only understood `true` or `false`, so it crashed too. I made `undefined` count as off, same as before.

The rest was just noise: deprecation notices from the bumped packages, not real failures. Build now finishes with 8 warnings and 0 errors.
